notes.title: Major Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's been some time since my last update so I am here to let you guys know what's happening and what the future for this game holds.

For the last few months I've been thinking about how to improve the game and I realized that I spent too much time and effort on making the game look good or at least better than what it was before rather than making the game more fun to play. My focus now is to increase content and better the gameplay experience. 

Before I get into details, I want to announce my new PATREON page. At the moment it is basic, but I will continue to develop it alongside the game and will eventually add rewards. Any donations to my PATREON are highly appreciated and all funds will go towards development of the game.

Here is my link to my PATREON:

https://patreon.com/SurvivorDevelopmentSupport?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=join_link


I have a little roadmap to show you guys the things I will be working on: (THIS ROADMAP REFERS TO JANUARY FOR NOW).

Early January (Today - January 12th)

- Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.3.
- Fix bugs in the current version.
- Complete a major cleanup of all the code in the project files, getting rid of unused code and files, improving organization, and optimizing code not just for performance but also to make it easier for me to expand on it, debug and test.

Mid January (January 13th - January 22nd)

- Major map rework. A new system that will use AI assistance to help me generate and build maps, this will reduce details but increase the size of the playing area and allow me to add features and whatnot.
- Shop will move out of in-game mode, instead shop is only accessible before and after completing a level.
- More weapons. To do this, I will be simplifying animations, specifically reloading. 
- Less detailed maps, and new tools will allow me to improve AI navigation and behavior. 
- Reworked wave system that includes: breaks in between rounds, boss rounds, special rounds and a day/night cycle.

Late January (January 23rd - January 30th)

- More maps. 
- Return of grenades and healthpacks. 
- Return of the teleporter, which will function differently in that it unlocks once the player completes a level. 
- Introduction of armor mechanic, armor can be purchased from the shop in-between rounds.
- More bosses.

Post January

- More maps.
- More enemy types.
- More bosses.
- More weapons.
- Weapon firing types (Kinetic/Energy). 
- Different projectile types (Bullet/Plasmaball/Laser)
- Firing Modes (Single/Burst/Automatic).
- Shield Mechanic (Works with Armor).
- Ability to upgrade Armor and Shields.
- Perks, Skills and Abilities.
- Saving and Loading System.
- Character Classes.

For reference, Post January refers to the rest of the year, although the list of things I want to do in the Post January list is fairly short since that is sort of the core things I want to work on, I will be adding a lot more. 

I am very excited for this year's development for Survivor and am looking forward to seeing how much the game will change and improve.

Thank you to all those who have supported this game, and a even bigger thank you if you've been around for a while, even since day 1! 

Kind Regards,
KolaCape

notes.title: v0.3.34 - Patch Notes + Info
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Before I get into v0.3.34's patch notes here is a rundown of what is happening:

MULTIPLAYER HAS BEEN DISABLED DUE TO:

 A very critical issue that has been discovered.
 A new system is being implemented to replace the old one, which requires maintenance and re-writing of major networking and multiplayer features.


Multiplayer will be disabled for a few days while I work on v0.3.35. Additionally, the planned content update for the inventory has been delayed to next week while I work on multiplayer.

While multiplayer is disabled, you will not be able to create or join lobbies. Single player is functional.

Patch Notes


 Fixed a critical bug that prevented the clients from being able to deal damage to zombies sometimes.
 Fixed a critical bug that prevented servers from not showing up sometimes in the server browser list.
 Fixed a critical bug where attachment functionality for buying and integrating attachments for weapons would not function correctly (certain sights were not being spawned in at the right locations and aim points were not correctly aligned or configured).
 Fixed a bug where a pickup truck had no collision mesh and could be walked through by the player.
 Fixed a bug with the T-15 Red Dot Sight, where the aim points were too low.
 Fixed a bug where when trying to join an in-game session, the Joining screen would not be destroyed.

notes.title: v0.3.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hey all, I apologize for the lack of posts, my flu returned and has been on and off a bunch recently (not COVID, just a bad flu) but now I am finally completely well and as of last week development has resumed at full speed.

I have resolved a number of issues that I discovered and during my testing also encountered a critical network bug that I have thankfully been able to resolve.

notes.title: Survivor v0.3.3 - Public Beta Release Window Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey all, I would like to apologies for the lack of development blogs, it's been a bit hectic over here and lots of things to sort out. But I want to announce that development did not end and that I have created a release window for the public beta of v0.3.3.

You might wonder why I decided on a public beta, and that's because testing multiplayer especially on a larger scale is tricky on my current setup and it will be very helpful to me to have those who can play and test while also getting the community involved. 

Some Changes

A few changes have been made to v0.3.3. The level and ranking system have been removed due to problems with their development, levels will be implemented in the next update and the rank system has been moved to a future update, TBC. 

What I am working on

Currently, I am polishing the game and finishing off a few final stuff. I am expecting a few more days needed for development.

When is the release window for the public beta?

The release window will open on Wednesday June 21st and close on Monday June 26th. 

During this time, the Public Beta will be released alongside key information such as access codes and how long the Public Beta will be available for.

Thank you to everyone for continuing to support the game and I am very excited to begin this new multiplayer journey with the player base and community. 

Kind Regards,
KolaCape

notes.title: v0.3.2 - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi all, since I released v0.3.1 I have been at work preparing for the next update. I have made enough progress to know roughly when the new update will be released. 

The new update (v0.3.2), will be releasing this week on Friday, March 31st, 2023. 

What will be added in the new update?

- A procedural recoil system configured for each weapon. Rifles with higher power have more recoil than the pistol for example. Aiming down sights also reduces recoil slightly for each weapon.
- An Aim down Sights (ADS) system for each weapon that allows you to be more accurate when shooting the hordes of zombies. 
- A reworked 3D workbench for buying and managing weapons. Each weapon can viewed as there 3D model and in addition the UI has been improved to be more user-friendly and professional.
- Skins and improved zombie animations - a bunch of new animations for zombies and the addition of skins. On top of skins, a spawning system for diversifying zombies so that each zombie looks different by having different hair styles, clothing type and color of clothing. 
- Improved SFX for zombies, zombies make noises when close to the player, when chasing and when dying. 
- A icon displayed above ammo counter showing the weapon currently equipped by the player.
- The addition of music that plays during a wave and alongside that music plays when transitioning waves as well.
- Additional UI effects such as a flashing health bar when health is low and flashing wave number to notify the player of a wave starting/ending. 
- Reworked and redesigned map to be larger but also fit the post-apocalyptic theme better.
- Reworked lighting to create a gloomier, dark atmosphere for fit with the post-apocalyptic vibe better. 

Was there anything supposed to be in this update that has been moved to future update or been removed?

- I was planned on making the weapon workbench 3D models to be interactive, so that the player could inspect weapons. However, while it is working, it hasn't turned out the way I wanted it to so I have decided to postpone the release of the 3D model interaction to a future update when it is more polished. 

Thank you for to everyone for supporting the game and I looking forward to everyone playing the new update and helping to advance the game! :)

notes.title: v0.3.11 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
Here are the release notes for v0.3.11. 

Exploders and Tanks now start running after reaching a certain wave. Exploders start running at Wave 10 and after and Tanks start running at Wave 15 and after. 

Increased melee attack range for Minions (blue zombie) and Tanks by 25%.

Increased melee attack damage for Minions (blue zombie) and Tanks by 53% (roughly). 

Increased damage caused by Exploder’s by 100% and increased minimum damage by four times (roughly).

Increased Exploder damage radius by 20%. 

Reduced Exploding zombie’s damage falloff by 20%. 

Added damage functionality to Exploder zombies when they die not just when activating when close to the player. Now Exploders also cause radial damage when they are killed by the player. 

Reduced Exploder zombie timer (from activation to explosion) by 15%. 

Edited Main Menu options panel and moved it to the center of the screen. Reduced transparency of the options panel. 

Reduced transparency of the weapon workbench menu and added a credits counter to the workbench to show the player how much credits they have and keep track of their credits when making purchases. 

Reduced cost of purchasing ammo from the weapon workbench and increased ammo received for each ammo purchase.
 
Made the following increases to credits earned for each killed enemy class:
- Minions (blue zombie) 50 >>> 75
- Exploders 100 >>> 150
- Tanks 250 >>> 350

All enemies reward additional credits when they start running. Minions (blue zombies) increase credits reward from 75 to 100, Exploders increase credits reward from 150 to 200, Tanks increase credits reward from 350 to 500.

notes.title: v0.3.1 - Release Notes/v0.3.2 Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey all, I would like to thank everyone for helping out with the BETA test as it helped me identify a number of problems and bugs for me to fix. 

I am now moving v0.3.1 to the public branch and release it officially on Steam!

Workbench:

- Workbench UI has been reworked so that the player can see 2D Images of each weapon.

- Added three new weapons: the Vanguard and XT15A, XT15B.

- When reloading weapons, only the ammo that is needed to fill the clip is taken instead of a full clip like previous versions.
- All weapons have a Range Factor which calculates how much damage falls off depending on the distance that a projectile travels.

Movement

Gameplay

v0.3.2 Announcement

The next update to be released will be v0.3.2 and here the following details about this update:

- Procedural recoil for all weapons

notes.title: v0.3.1 Version 3 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey all, this is the third Patch for v0.3.1 on the BETA branch (the first public PATCH). 

Critical Bug Fixes:

- Fixed a bug where the player could spam reload while automatic shooting and be able to reload without having to play any animations.
- Fixed map boundaries by adding blockers to prevent players from being able to escape the map. 
- Fixed a bug that caused reload times to be delayed by an extra second for the second Primary weapon slot.
- Fixed a bug that causes zombies to stop spawning on some waves. This might have multiple causes and it is not a guaranteed fix, although I am fairly certain that the cause was because the zombie’s visual range was too small.
- Fixed a bug that causes overexaggerated collision force feedback when characters collide. Improved collision boxes and reduced force feedback to prevent characters from being launched and going flying. 
- Fixed a bug where the modular pieces of the XT15A and XT15B would spawn in mid-air after purchasing them from the weapon workbench.
- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to swap the current weapon they’re holding to the same weapon. 

Content Additions/Changes

- Added scaling health mechanic for enemies. All zombies will start off with their base health and then it will increase until it is capped by a Maximum Health Scale factor which is different for each enemy. 
- Reduced weapon damage and headshot multiplier has also been reduced slightly as well. The weapon nerfs are the result of the weapons dealing too much damage, especially at lower waves. 
- Increased reload timer so that ammo count updates when magazine is inserted into gun.
- Reduced fire rate of guns to more realistic levels.
- Reduced size of crosshair. 

I AM AWARE OF LIGHTING AND SHADOW ISSUES AND HAVE CHANGED SOME PARAMETERS TO DO WITH LIGHTING.

PLEASE REPORT ANY BUGS YOU FIND.

Thank you for helping to test Survivor and to support the game's development.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - v0.3 - New Map + New Effects + Ruins Extension + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Additions:

- Added a level teleporter that the player will be required to collect three keys for in order to unlock and travel to the next level. 
- Added new level 'Dunes' which is still in beta and work in progress with components changing overtime.
- Added blood effects to the zombies when shot by the player.
- Added death sound effects as well as random SFX for the zombies. 
- Added new UI effects when a key is spawned, acquired or inserted into the teleporter.
- Added basic visual effects for teleporter when inserting keys.
- Added new Horde Mode that becomes active once the second key is inserted.
- Added a major extension to map 'Ruins' with forests surrounding the map and zombies coming from in-between the trees. 
- Added new sound indicators when keys are spawned, acquired or inserted.
- Redid the options menu to include additional options as well to become tidier and more visually appealing. 
- Added new and improved loading screens when travelling between levels.
- Added a Day/Night cycle. 

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed a bug where the player could buy the shotgun again, resulting in a loss of credits. 
- Fixed a bug where the mage zombie would not move after being spawned.
- Fixed a bug where the ammo crates would not provide ammo for the shotgun.


Teleporter:

- A new addition to the game is the teleporter which will now act as gate, allowing the player(s) to travel to the next level. In order for the player to travel through the teleporter they must acquire and insert three keys:

- The first key is called the Activation Key and is spawned in one of three random locations on the map at Wave 5. It must be inserted first and before the other two keys.

- The second key is called the Exploration Key and has a chance to be dropped by an armored zombie after its death. It must be inserted second and once put into the teleporter will activate Horde Mode where zombies will spawn faster, have more health and movement speed. A charge bar will also appear, indicating the amount of charge containing within the teleporter. The player must defend until the teleporter is fully charged at which point, Horde Mode ends.

- The third key is called the Expedition Key and must be purchased from the weapon workbench. It can only be inserted into the teleporter once the other two keys have been inserted and the teleporter has been fully charged. On being inserted, the player(s) will be teleported to the next map. 

Multiplayer News

- In August of this year, I attempted to create multiplayer and allow for players to form lobbies, join them and play together against the zombie hordes. Due to the challenge of developing multiplayer and my lack of experience, I decided to put the project for later date when I felt more comfortable developing it. Well I have good news, I recently have been studying documentation and becoming more experienced, I am ready to take on the challenge of developing multiplayer again. The next major update for the game will be the addition of multiplayer. 

Future Development

- For those of you who are wondering about the game's future development I will continue to make small updates here and there, adding minor changes such as some content, bug fixes and map changes/improvements. Multiplayer is now my focus and will be the next major update for the game. 

Thank you to those who have to continued to stick by the game's development and continue to support it.

notes.title: v0.3 Release Date Announcement + Separating game content into series of updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Survivor dev, kolacape here, back with another announcement. It's been some time since my previous announcement and I wanted to shed some light on what I've been working on plus some changes I've decided to make to the new update and future ones.

Firstly, v0.3 will only contain multiplayer, nothing else will be added in this new update. 

Secondly, I have decided that a better way for me to engage with the community is to separate major updates into a series of smaller updates so that I can get feedback for each new addition to the game. Releasing major updates means more time between updates and also large additions can bring a lot of bugs or other issues. Smaller updates will help me better keep track of the content I add to the game and allow me to be more active in the community.

Finally, I would like to announce v0.3's release date which is September 12th. 

I would like to again thank everyone for their continued support and loyalty towards the game, it really means a lot and helps keep the game alive! :)

notes.title: v0.3 - MAJOR UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Survivor dev here to bring you some exciting news! With the recent feedback and continuous growth of the game, I have decided to prepare and develop the game's first major update that will bring a lot of new content and features.

What will be added in this new update?

- Multiplayer
A highly requested feature from you guys, this new version will have basic multiplayer, allowing players to create lobbies and invite their friends to play. 

- Three New Weapons
Three additional weapons will be added in this new update: an assault rifle, a sniper and a shotgun. 

- A new map
A whole new map for players to battle the hordes of zombies. This map will be around twice as large as the other map. 

- Two new zombie types
Two new zombies will join the hordes, an armored version of the exploder and a unique zombie type: the mage who will be the first ranged enemy of the game.

- More options
A new user interface for changing graphics and other options that will allow players on slower computers to play as well as fine tune the settings to their needs.

- Optimization
Re-writing code and other improvements to help the game run more smoothly. 

How long will the update take?

My current estimate is anywhere between 3 - 5 weeks. This estimate is based on my own skill level and the challenges of developing certain features that will be present in the new update. Along the way, however I will continue make small updates here and there. As for a release date, this will be announced roughly one week before the update's completion. 

Are you still taking suggestions for v0.3?

Yes! If anyone has any ideas or suggestions they like to include in this new update, simply reply with your idea to this announcement. I will look over every idea thoroughly and decide whether to include them in the new update or a later one. 

Thank you to all those who are still playing and loyal to the game! I can't wait to show you everything I have been working on in this new major update.

notes.title: v0.2 Release Date + Leaving Pre-Alpha
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! It's been a week since I announced that I would begin work on v0.2 which is currently still in development, however it is complete enough for me to announce a release date. This date will be August 8th and will include a number of various changes and improvements. 

Some things you might see in the new update is:

- A slightly improved user interface.
- A new menu.
- An in-game options menu that allows you to look at controls and change options on the fly.
- The weapon workbench that was discussed in the previous announcement.
- New weapons.

And MORE!

The other major change that is happening, is that the game is leaving Pre-Alpha. v0.2 also called Alpha 1 will be the first Alpha version of the game. What does this mean for the game's development? Personally, I didn't know how far I would go with the game's development when the game launched initially, but the feedback was positive and provided me with the information I needed. By transitioning into from Pre-Alpha to Alpha, my goals will be much more complex and the effort and time I will place into development will double. 

The other major change that will come about with the transition is implementing a price tag. Initially, the budget I had to create the game was very small, but it increased thanks to people in my personal life. However that budget is now coming to end and in order to increase the speed of development and complexity of the game, placing a price on the game is a requirement. All money received from purchases of the game will go to directly funding the game's development and are purely in the interest of financial aiding the game's progress. I know this might be a controversial decision but it is also important for the game's success.

Anyway, now that's out of the way, I can't wait to see your guys' reactions to the new v0.2 which will be releasing on August 8th! See you then! :)

notes.title: v0.2 MAJOR UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Survivor dev here. 

I am making this announcement as I have some news regarding the game's development. The first piece of news is that a new minor update: v0.1.5b, which will be released later today with a new main menu and fixing an annoying bug to do with mouse sensitivity. 

The next news is a major update that I am working on: v0.2. This will be the first major update of the game, however it will require some time to complete. Currently I do not have a specific date set for when this update will be released, however I do have a rough estimate for when this new update will be released which will be in 2 - 3 weeks. The update will bring a lot of new features and content into the game that I hope will make the game feel a whole lot more complete. Although I want to keep the details about the update a surprise, here are few things I will be adding in the next update that I have decided with you guys:

Weapon workbench
- This workbench will be available in each map and will allow the player to buy new weapons and upgrade their current weapons by adding attachments.

Overhauled user interface
- The user interface will look much better, with flashier visuals and whatnot.

New guns
- I plan to add a decent amount of new weapons into the game, with different sound effects, damage and cost.

Economy system
- For every kill, you will earn a certain amount of credits. By earning credits you will be able to purchase upgrades and new weapons at the workbench. 

New zombie types
- Additional zombie types that will increase the diversity amongst the hordes you battle and add interesting and unique challenges.

And a whole lot more are coming. As stated above, I do not wish to spoil much more in order to keep the update a surprise. As for the release date of the update, this will become apparent to me when the update is nearly finished and thus I will make a new announcement once it is ready!

I also plan to make 2 - 3 very minor updates to the game that will fix any bugs I catch, as well as minor improvements/changes here and there. These updates will be released during the development time of v0.2, so during the 2 -3 weeks I will continue to support and improve the game. Also if there any SUGGESTIONS that you have, please don't be afraid to write them down, I would love to hear what the community would like to me change/improve/add.

I would like to thank everyone who is continued to show their loyalty and support for the game, it means a lot to me and helps to keep the game alive!

notes.title: Update v0.1.5a
notes.notes:
Change Notes:

- Fixed a bug where the exploding zombie would sometimes not damage the player.
- Fixed screen resolution changing window-size, now it changes resolution of the game while keeping it fullscreen.
- Added a slider bar for volume.
- Added a slider bar for mouse sensitivity.
- Added some minor improvements to AI navigation.

notes.title: Update v0.1.5 - Medium-Sized Update
notes.notes:
Change Notes:

- Replaced "boss zombie" with "armored zombie".
- Added new zombie type "armored zombie".
- Replaced gun model with higher resolution M-16.
- Added advanced first-person animations.
- Added new gun sound effects.
- Changed muzzle flash.
- Improved spawn system to increase performance.
- Changed spawn system to increase spawn rate of certain zombies to increase difficulty more exponentially. 
- Added new gun reload effects.
- Removed unused assets. 
- Patched additional exploits.
- Moved patches of grass to improve map look.
- Added directional light to represent sky map.
- Increased brightness slightly.
- Added siren that plays at the end of each round.

notes.title: Update v0.0.5 (July 14, 2021)
notes.notes:
Change Notes:

- Changed skeletal mesh of ammunition crates.
- Added pop-up widget for ammo crates.
- Removed chunks of unused code.
- Improved code optimization.
- Added new assets for later use in future updates.
- Patched player able to jump on statues.
- Patched player able to jump on firepits.
- Moved statues backwards slightly to stop player from being to fit behind them.
- Improved AI navigation
- Added additional navigation links to improve AI jumping
